content: O'no tabenasoo soo Te Pabe'e ka nobe-wi'yoona mease, ka banunadu-kumaba petuoogase oona katu.
Mu numu tubetse ewa'yoo ka oo na'oonnakwi manepunnena oo taakoo'napunne, soo Te Pabe'e yise ka sake-wi tsebooese oe katu, mu numu ewa'yoo punno'o ka baa-kumana konnopunne.
Soo Te Pabe'e mu tunedyooena mu natugwenga katu, mee mu netamma, “Soo nana tumasua'a.
Susumudu soo oo pooe matu ka a nadapoohabe-witoo sawehoose mu hootseba'a mu sooa.
Susumudu oo pooe tubebu'a-matu punno'o oona tupe-nagatoo gi tookapu teepu-ga-witoo sawehoose yabesoo naahoose sapa,
soo taba mu kootuikuhoo, umu ka gi tookaputoo tunahabena.
Susumudu mu a pooe punno'o tsa'abu-nagatoo sawehoose, naase sapa, soo tsa'abu ka ewa naana mu tatsatsebooge.
Susumudu besow teepu-koobatoo sawese besa naakese ewa pooetooa.
Mu sakwa ka mumme e tunedyooe-makoo a nakasopedakwadoose mamakoo natunedyooe.”
Numme Te Pabe'e nakatzimodu Te Pabe'e-baa petugase mee'e oo tubenga, “How manena u ka mu numu natugwenga?”

Soo Te Pabe'e yise ne nanekwegease mee unakwe, “Mu e nakatzimodu mooasoo nasootuhipu. Mu mooasoo oo nakasopedakwadoo ka Te Naa unnepu. Mu nasootuhipu pana mu numu gisoo ookow nasootuha'e, ooonne'yoona nu meeoo mu natugwenga katu Te Naa nuka tunetammakuna.
Soo tooe haga tooe numu ka sagwane tunaka'oedyukuse, saa'a oo-no meadabena unusoo tunaka'oedyuku manepetugakwu. Tooe haga tooe numu ka gi tunaka'oedyukuna hanobasoo gi tunaka'oedyuku manekwu.
Ooonne'yoona nu mu numu natuukwe'nga. ‘Tooe mu numu oo poonnepana, umu gi ooka tu nakasopedakwatoona petzape. Tooe mu numu oo nakapana, gi oo naka'oedyukute.’

O'nosoo Te Naa yadooawabe Isaiah mee naneadu mu numu manekwu-kwitu botugupu, mee na'unakwe, ‘Mu ooosapa ka Te Naa besa unnepu nakamo, pana gi oo soonaka'oedyukute. Mu tuwazoo tooe oo poonne pana gi oo soo nakasoopedakwadoo.

Mu numu ka Te Naa besa unnepu tu nakasopedakwadookwuna gi petzape, too'e mumme tu tuukwe sapa. Mu sakwa ka mumme oo tuukwena naka'oedyukuna, mu poonnena nakasopedakwadoona, o'no sakwa mu nu-matoo kemmase, nu yise mu sootuhikwu.’
Nu mu sootuhikwu mu ka oo nakana, oo oedyukuna ka mumme e tuukwena, oo poonnena, oo nakasopedakwadoona ka e manena.

Nu togesapa mu tuukwekwu, o'nosoo mu nanamooatupu ewa'yoo mu Te Naa yadooawabe, mu kukumma'yooosoo bebesa'yoo numu e tooe soopoonne pana e tooe soonaka pana gi hownnekoo oo mane-wa'ne'yoo. O'nosoo nu gi mu nanamooatupu-baa pana meno'o mu nasootuhipu nu ka mu-baa petuse.
E nakapunne nu ka e natugwenga-kwitu mu tunedyooekwu. Esoo natugwengapu-kwitu, tamme ka Te Naa naka'oedyukudu.

Susumudu ka Te Naa unnepu naka pana gi oo oedyukuna ooonne'yoona ka a pooe a natapohabeku-kwitoo a sawe-kwa'ne'yoo. Soo a pooe ka Te Naa unnepu-kwa'ne'yoo. Soo gi toge'yoo ka Te Naa unnepu-witu mu numu nemooagatu, oosoo yise ka hootseba'a-wa'ne'yoosoo ka a ewana ka a pooe kwakwape oo totsopetahookwu. Yoo mu numu hanobasoo gi tunaka'oedyuku manekwu. Oosoo ka a pooe a nadapodo-wi namasuadu-kwa'nesoo.
Susumudu numu-matoo sumuna ka tupe-nagatoo a pooe nabebu'a-kwa'ne'yoo ka Te Naa unnepu nakana, besa Te Naa unnepu-matoo nakasokwama.
Mu nanewohonena mu numu yabesoo tunaka'oedyukumakwukwu.

Susumudu numu sumuna ka a pooe mu tsa'abu-nagatoo sawe-kwa'ne'yookwu. Mu numu ka Te Naa unnepu nakapana ka ewa tu heetooana sumu petukute, yise ka teepu-kooba tooe hownnekoo tooe suda oo soonammekute. Esoo ka besa te too'e tunakapu tamatzooekukwu.

Pana mu numu-matu ka a pooe besow teepuna namasuadu-kwa'ne'yoo, umu ka besa na'unnedu nakase oo naka'oedyukukwu. Umu ka besa-kwi natumasuakudu-kwa'ne'yookwu ka ewow besow pooe saawe-wa'ne ka Te Naa unnepu naka'oedyukute. Tamme ka Te Naa besa unnepu mu numu tuukwena, o'no ewa'yoo umu numu tunaka'oedyukukwu.”

Soo Te Pabe'e yise kumma'akoosoo mu numu natugwenga tunedyooe tuwow. “Mu tunaka'oedyukudu ka mu gi tunaka'oedyudu-no namayu'a yaa teepu-koobatu. Ka nana tubewabe-ga'yoo-kwa'ne, soo numu tubewabe hee-ga'yoo puu ka besow tu pooe suu'mu masuakute.
Mu numu yise tumasuamakwuse ka tu yongose utuika ka tu woho togabama tu tubewabe-wi petuse ka tsa'abu pooe ka besow tumasuape-nagatoo pebu'ase mea'a.
Ka tumasuape besa naahookese, soo tsa'abu punno'o oo-nagakwi namayuadu naahooke.
Soo tumasuadu tummatzidu mee oo netamma, ‘Numme oo sopedakwadoo ka besow a pooe mawe tubewabe-wi u masuase. How yise manena mu tsa'abue punno'o umu-nagakwi na'a?’
Soo tumasuadu mee'e mu nanekwegea, ‘Oosoo nuka woho'nedu ka sumuna mow manakwe.’ Umu oo tummatzidu mee oo netamma, ‘Numme sakwa mu tsa'abu tzanooedapebu'a.’
Soo tubewabe hee-ga'yoo mee'e mu nanekwegea, ‘Gi meno'osoo. Mu sumuna ka besow tumasuape nokosoo ka tsa'abu tzanooe'dakwunidooa ka meno'osoo oo manena.
Ka tumasuape nayasakwuse, nu saa'a mu yasadu mee netammadooa, Ka tsa'abu mooe hanese, nana-ma mu wutamase mu tuni. O'no saa'a yise ka besow tu pooe e tubane nobe-kwi tubane.’ ”

Soo Te Pabe'e yise mu numu tuwazoo kumma'akoosoo natugwenga ka mu numu nanesootuhidu mane-kwitu. Sumu'yoo natugwengape meeoo yise oo soo puu ka tuutsekoo a pooe manakwana suakese ka saa'a naakese pabatse suakese paba manepetugase nana'emota ma'natooakwu. Mu hootseba'a yise oo ma'na-ma mesoo aata yoohoo soo nanesootuhibu manepunne. Meno'o numme tutunaka'oedyukute huutse'yoosoo ka saa'a ewow numu tunaka'oedyukudu manese ka tutsekoo a pooe paba naa petuga-kwa'ne manekwu nana'emota ma'naga-kwa'ne manepetugakwu.

Soo Te Pabe'e ooosapa mu numu tuwazoo natugwengayakwe ka umu-matu tunaka'oedyukute ewa'yoosoo numu saa'a tunaka'oedyuku manekwu. Mee'e yise unakwe, “Ka mogo'ne tukaba tohanedyidu-kwa'ne. Oosoo puu ka tumayua'a hongobe noko mooe mayu'ase, ka saa'a soo oo tukabadoona besa koposekwu.”
Soo Te Pabe'e ewow numu nanatuukwe'e hemma mu nakasopedakwatoo-kwikoo yise mu ewow numu mana'yoona saa'a ka nanatugwengapu tu nakatzimodu tunesootabuedooa.
Soo o'nosoo Te Naa yadooawabe ka Te Pabe'e natugwengakwu-kwitu wahana, mee'e tubotugupu, “Nu mu Pabe'e mu natugwengakwu ka gi hannano'o mu nakapugana.”

Soo Te Pabe'e ka mu numu baa'yoona me'ase ka nobe-kwi ka numme pumme nakatzimodu-no tzoonooahooka. Numme yise meeoo ka Te Pabe'e tubenga, “Numme gi ka natugwenga-kwitu nakasopedakwadoo, hayoo u unnena?”
Soo Te Pabe'e yise mee'e ne nanekwegea, “Nu ka tumasuadu-kwa'ne'yoo.

No'yoona numu ka teepu-koobatu yaatuoo ka tubewabe-kwa'nesoo manepunne. Mu numu nuka nanesootuhidu bebesow a pooe-kwa'ne'yoo. Mu numu ka sutakoo nakabetseadu punno'o ka sutakoo tsa'abu sua-kwa'ne'yoo.
Soo Gi Toge'yoo e wohonedu ka tsa'abu masuapu. Ka saa'a soo Te Naa eka teepu-koobatu mu numu nemadabuekwu. Mu toha kakasa-ga'yoo ka Te Naa tummatzikwu.

Nu ka mu toha kakasa-gakoo, nuka tummatzidu yaa teepu-koobatoo tayakwu, o'no umu ka mu tuma'emukwadu numu kadoo'oo mayugwekwu. Ka mu tsa'abu natunikwu-kwa'ne, umu ka sutakoo numu goso gi tookedu-witoo ma'anakwu. Umu suda sokwamana sakwikwu. O'no soo Te Naa ka teepu atasoo mayugwekwu.
Umu numu Te Naa-matoo nanesootuhidu ooosapa padakwetseaakwu ka taba-kwa'ne, ka Te Naa-baa'yoona. Mu sakwa e nakapunnena a nakasopedakwadoo.

Soo Te Naa God tubetse besa te sootuha'e tamme ka Te Pabe'e besa nakabetseana, ka yaa'a teepu-koobatu hemma te heegana oooonakwasoo besa'yoo mee oo sooyugwena, ka hemma puma tu tumuna tubewabe-wi watze nagoodu-kwa'ne. Soo numu ka oo mayuse oo watze tugukwusoo yise no'oko tu hemmama tumuse ka tabewabe tumukwusesoo, oosoo besa soonammena ka hemma puma tu tumukwuna nawatzetugu-matoo.
Tamme sakwa oo tubetse soogwi ka Te Naa tamme sootuhikwuna.
Soo numu puu unu nanenagadu tsomebe mayuhoose, ka unu oo sookwina no'oko tu hemma-ma tumuse yise ka umu tu soogwina tsomebe tumukwu.

Ekow teepu-koobatu, mu tunaka'oedyukudu mu gi tunaka'oedyukudu-no namayu'a, umu ka pakwe nuukwi-kwa'ne'yoo. Soo numu puu ka puma tu tukwina ka paa-witoo tzakwekuse no'obatusoo pakwe hanehookwu susumudu besa'hoo, susumudu gi besa'hoo.
Ka tu tukwinoo kaanohoose bakumanatoo oo tzapewoyaga. Oosoo ka besow pakwe tu kawona-wi hanemena ka sutakoo yise tapebuamena.
Ka Te Naa ka teepu atasoo yugwese mu toha kakasagakoo Te Naa tutummatziwabe mu numu nanasukwesoo yugwe, mu bebesahoo sugwesoo, mu sutakoo too sugwebasoo, ka mu pakwe nuukwi-kwa'ne.
Mu suta'yoo ka goso gi tokedu-witoo nahanekwunikwu umu suda sokwamana sakwikwu.
Mu haa'a ka mumme e tuukwena nakasopedakwatoo?” mee'esoo Te Pabe'e ka mu numu tubenga. Umu oo nanekwegea, “Aha numme tooe besa oo nakasopedakwatoo.”

Soo Te Pabe'e yise mee mu netamma, “Soo mooa tumayohope sopedakwadoodu ka meno'o mumme e tunedyooepu nakasopedakwadoose, o'no oosoo besakoosoo mu numu tunedyooekwu. How'oo puu soo numu pudutupu nokosoo mooatupu hee-ga'yoo tu nobe-kwikoo yise mu wutzadyupa, 'yoo manepunnedu unu besa'yoo.”
Soo Te Pabe'e ka mu natugwengamakwuse,

tu nanumu-baasoo kodyu petuga. Ka mu numu-baa nanesootuhi petuga, ka mu numu besasoo Te Naa-witu tuukwena. Mu numu oe oo nakapunnedu meeoo netamma, “Ha'oo yise soo Jesus besa yadooa, pana oosoo sukwe tamme-matusoo?
Tamme oo sopedakwatoo oosoo Mary sukwe tooa. Mu James, Joseph, Judas, Simon yise a wanga'amu.
Yise a punne'emu yow tamme-naga. Ha'oo yise soo Jesus unu pooha-ga'yoo?”

Ooonne'yoona yise umu gi ka Te Pabe'e naka'oedyukute. Soo Te Pabe'e yise mee'e mu netamma, “Ka yaa teepu-koobatu mu numu ka Te Naa yadooawabe naka'oedyukukwu, oogowsoo nanumu, oo nonopua'amu-no suu'mu gi.”
Huutsekoosoo numu tuoegoedu-matu oetu soo Te Pabe'e mabesaku, umu ka gi tunaka'oedyukuna.
